sections.name: Calibration
sections.detail: Fitted on the events before the cut date and measured on those after it. The calibrated score is the probability that the cause the system named is the window's dominant cause.

measurements.name: expected calibration error
measurements.detail: count-weighted mean gap between predicted and observed hit rate

measurements.name: Brier score
measurements.detail: mean squared error of the probability forecast; informational

measurements.name: discrimination (AUC)
measurements.detail: probability a correct call outranks an incorrect one. 0.5 is none: a well-calibrated score with no discrimination is a constant at the base rate, which is honest but uninformative

measurements.name: observed base rate
measurements.detail: how often the named cause was the dominant one, across the holdout

sections.name: Attribution
sections.detail: Graded against the window's dominant cause, weighted by each concurrent event's own recorded contribution pro-rated to the overlapping days. Claims naming only a channel are ungradeable — the corpus plants no channel mechanism — and are excluded from the denominator, not scored wrong.

measurements.name: top-cause accuracy
measurements.detail: chance on 5 regions is 20%

measurements.name: share mean relative error
measurements.detail: estimated share of the NET gap against the ledger's share of planted magnitude, on correctly named segments in windows clearing the materiality floor. The two denominators are not identical, which is stated rather than corrected for

measurements.name: share median relative error
measurements.detail: the same comparison at the median. The mean is dominated by windows where segments move in opposite directions, so the NET gap in the denominator is far smaller than the gross movement the ledger's share is built from; the median shows the typical case

measurements.name: ungradeable claims
measurements.detail: claims naming only a dimension the ledger records no truth for

sections.name: Detection
sections.detail: A flagged day counts as a true positive when it falls inside any ledger event window; 61% of scanned days are inside one, which is the precision a coin would achieve. An event is recalled when at least one of its days was flagged.

measurements.name: precision lift over chance
measurements.detail: precision divided by the share of scanned days that lie inside some event window. This, not raw precision, is the graded number: with 61% of days inside an event, a fixed precision target below that figure would be met by flagging days at random

measurements.name: precision
measurements.detail: raw, against a 61% chance baseline

measurements.name: recall over the whole corpus
measurements.detail: includes events planted below the noise floor on purpose

sections.name: Endogeneity
sections.detail: Media budget is set as a share of revenue with a tactical overlay that responds to last week's performance, so a naive regression of log units on log adstocked spend is biased by construction. Both estimates are shown against the value planted in the world config.

measurements.name: naive elasticity
measurements.detail: log units on log adstocked spend, nothing else — what a ROAS tile does

measurements.name: DAG-specified elasticity
measurements.detail: with price, fill rate, trend and annual seasonality, Newey-West errors, and the mediator (unit volume) deliberately excluded

measurements.name: planted elasticity
measurements.detail: sum of the six per-channel elasticities, read from the world config

measurements.name: times closer to truth than naive
measurements.detail: the graded number. The LEVEL is not recovered within 20% and is recorded as a known issue with its measured value

sections.name: Narrative
sections.detail: Every number in every generated sentence re-extracted and re-checked against the evidence bundle by the deterministic verifier. Citation coverage is measured over PUBLISHED claims: one the cite-or-drop filter rejected never reaches a reader.

measurements.name: numeric fidelity
measurements.detail: every numeral in every narrative matched a computed fact

measurements.name: citation coverage
measurements.detail: published claims resting on a document that is in the bundle

measurements.name: cite-or-drop rejection rate
measurements.detail: proposed claims the filter rejected; informational, but a rate of zero would mean the filter is never exercised

sections.name: Entitlements
sections.detail: Every contract compiled for every role; the compiled SQL itself is inspected, because that is where the guarantee lives — a mask absent from the statement cannot be put back downstream.

measurements.name: entitlement leakage
measurements.detail: no compiled statement omitted a declared mask or row filter

measurements.name: policies that will not compile
measurements.detail: every declared policy compiles

tier_basis: contract bands; no fitted reliability curve yet
ranker_status: 0 labels, below the 60 floor; using rules
notes: calibration: fitted on 274 events but NOT adopted: holdout discrimination is 0.520, below the 0.55 floor, so the map is a constant at the base rate and the bands derived from it would admit nothing
tier boundaries fall back to the contract's own bands; the system reports itself uncalibrated rather than claiming a calibration it has not earned
